{{Short description|German mathematician}}
'''Friedrich Paul Mahlo''' (born 28 July 1883 in [[Coswig, Saxony-Anhalt|Coswig]], [[Duchy of Anhalt]]; died 20 August 1971 in [[Halle (Saale)|Halle]], [[Bezirk Halle]]) was a [[German people|German]] [[mathematician]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20090710082208/http://dmv.mathematik.de/die-dmv/105-kurzbiographien/379-kurzbiographien-m.html Short biography of Paul Mahlo], [[Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung]] (in German), retrieved 2010-04-21.</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=37785}}</ref>

Mahlo introduced [[Mahlo cardinal]]s in 1911. He also showed that the [[continuum hypothesis]] implies the existence of a [[Luzin set]].
